scope: Theorem 2.3 (Length and nesting) of the manuscript “Mass and covering exponents for fixed-length honeycomb walks” (preprints/Mass-and-covering-exponents-for-fixed-length-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 58011713f8bb7cd5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the two face centers f1, f2 adjacent to p, 1 √ 2 (︁ Zf1 (D) + Zf2 (D) )︁ ≤ Lp(D) ≤ Zf1 (D) + Zf2 (D). The same comparison holds with finite quantities in every infinite strip of fixed positive height. Moreover, P2(r) = r1/12+o(1) and Sk = k1/12+o(1).
